name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

queryMaxLen.description:
Specifying the maximum number of tokens in the query, which should be strictly larger than 0.
The default value is 32.

numRetrievedPassages.description: Number of passages to be retrieved, default value is 4

maxNumRetrievedPassages.description:
The limit for #numRetrievedPassages, so it is not set too large when #numRetrievedPassages is modified by users.
# 25 is a somewhat arbitrary limit, but if users start setting the number too large, similaritySearch will slow down
# and we will start hitting token limits.

filterDocs.description: Whether to filter our passages with score less than doc_filter_threshold, default is False.

docFilterThreshold.description:
The threshold used for filtering passages out, default is 15. It is ignored if
filter_docs is False. The range for this parameter is between 0 and 1 if normalize_scores is set to True and
it is between 0 and query_max_len otherwise.

normalizeScores.description: Whether to normalize the score by query length or not. The default is False.

mmrSpec.description:
Spec for MMR (Maximal Marginal Relevance) post-processing of the similarity search results
to support summarization.
